text:
mira_ops: quick sync: partner SEV process — origin & comms. propose we document where SEV should be declared (marketplace support vs partner SI PM), which channel to use, and minimal warroom checklist. TL;DR: need one source-of-truth for declaring SEV. who can make the call? @dana_partner?

Dana_partner: we usually tag SEV when customer impact > 50% calls or blocking prod. SI partners sometimes open with 'critical' — needs triage. agree we need explicit origin rules.

jordan_pm: agenda pls. can we capture: 1) intake channel 2) who owns bridge 3) partner visibility 4) postmortem ownership 5) public comms?

lucas_sre: suggested flow: partner reports -> partner-support channel or marketplace ticket -> if > P0 then create shared channel + /warroom create partner-<id> -> page oncall -> assign SRE + Partner AE. minimal warroom checklist: runbook link, telemetry, customer contact, rollback plan.

olivia_cs: :+1: add 'who communicates to customer' (AE or CS lead), and 'who updates partner' (partner PM).

sam_k: we also need ticket labels + SLA windows. sample labels:
```labels: partner:SI, severity:P0, marketplace:true```
and command to create warroom:
```/warroom create "partner-sev-<cust>-<short>" --owners @lucas_sre,@dana_partner```

dana_partner: we should allow partner-reported issues to be escalated without AE approval if impact is validated by CS on call.

incident-bot: warroom created: https://remotesys/warrooms/1901234567-partner-sev-1 by @mira_ops

jordan_pm: question: marketplace listings — if the issue is global and model quality related, do we automatically notify marketplace? need an escalation checkbox in the warroom template.

lucas_sre: yes. propose checkbox: 'marketplace-impact: yes/no' and 'show-public-status-page: yes/no'. For model-quality, route to model-oncall and research.

mira_ops: ok action items:
- dana to draft 'origin rules' doc (where SEV can be declared)
- olivia to add communication owner table
- lucas to update warroom template with marketplace checkbox and ticket labels
- sam to add command snippets into playbook
I'll ping for a follow-up Wed 10am PT. @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if ok.

olivia_cs: :thumbsup:

dana_partner: :thumbsup: will start draft

sam_k: :thumbsup: I'll PR warroom template
